}) => any;

// Return heterocycle count.
type get_num_heterocycles = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_num_aromatic_heterocycles = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_fraction_aromatic_atoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_num_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_num_unspecified_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;
